issues.display_title: Issue #132: Embed access: draw MapThru Blue Line Maps for 8-character keys
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

/embed/access/{key} draws a user's tours from Martin, found by access id (16 characters). A MapThru Blue Line Map share key is 8 characters: for those keys the page draws the project's tour lines from MapThru instead. Needs GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#1171 deployed first (map-thru.com serves the lines).

Scope

  • src/app/embed/access/[accessId]: an 8-character key skips the access lookup and Martin, and draws the lines from https://map-thru.com/api/m/{key}/lines. NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTHRU_URL overrides the address.
  • The lines take Martin's look (colour and width; the access lineStyle setting wins), and the map opens fitted to the tours.
  • A click on a line opens the tour on TourMkr from its start. MapThru keeps no panorama ids, so there is no nearest-panorama jump as on Martin's lines.
  • 16-character access ids work as before. development/embed/access is unchanged.

Acceptance criteria

  • /embed/access/{8-character key} of a published Blue Line Map shows its tours, fitted, with no request to Martin.
  • Clicking a line opens the tour.
  • /embed/access/{access id} is unchanged.
  • tsc and eslint green.

RESULT

Implemented and merged to development (c5c66485, PR #133) on 2026-10-05. tsc --noEmit and eslint on the changed files pass.

What changed

  • src/app/embed/access/[accessId]/page.tsx: an 8-character key skips getAccess and Martin and renders the map with mapThruKey.
  • src/components/main/maps/source/mapthru/MapThruSource.tsx (new): reads ${NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTHRU_URL || 'https://map-thru.com'}/api/m/{key}/lines in the browser, draws the lines in Martin's look (the access lineStyle wins), fits the map to the answer's bbox, and opens https://tourmkr.com/F1{tourKey} on a click.
  • src/components/main/maps/container/main/MapContainer.tsx: mapThruKey prop. env.d.ts: NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTHRU_URL (optional).

Checked in a browser (GPU Chrome, this branch's dev server, /embed/access/fPMEbGwq): 8 of 8, the lines read with CORS, both tours drawn and fitted, no Martin tile or access request, Martin's colour, a click opens the tour. The basemap stayed blank on the local dev server with or without this change.

The API it reads is live: GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#1171, released to map-thru.com on 2026-10-05. Released to master (8b7dc3f5, PR #134) on 2026-10-05. The deploy to maps.gothru.co is manual.
